{{Top|leg}}
'''G'riles''' were goal cages used in the sport of [[phrenbi]]. The aim of the game was for the teams to use their [[urran]] to propel the [[b'rrsk]] into the g'riles.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
